text: Namaste! I am Parul — your Relationship Manager.
Today we will learn Google Maps together. It takes just eight minutes, and it is fun too.
First, one important thing — reading and writing are not needed at all. Just recognise colours and icons.
Green board, blue arrow, red balloon. With these three things you can reach anywhere.
And at the end there will be five small questions. I will ask the question, and you have to tap the right answer on the screen — press it with your finger.
If you get one wrong, no problem. You can try as many times as you like. Let us begin — keep the sound on.
This is your app. At the very top, today’s date — the twenty-eighth of July.
This green card — it says “Chal Raha Hai”. It means this job is going on right now.
And this white card — “Aane Wala”. This is your next job, at Sameer ji’s home.
To open that job, tap this arrow button. Just once.
The job is open. The clock at the top says — you must reach in fifty-five minutes.
Here is the customer’s name and full address. Do not try to read it — no need.
This green phone icon — to talk to the customer. If you have trouble finding the house, call from right here.
And now the most important thing. Look at this — the colourful icon. Green, yellow, blue, with a small red balloon on top.
This is Google Maps. Next to it, it says “Directions”. Tap it once, and Maps will open by itself.
And this purple button at the bottom — “Mark Aa Gaya”. Press it only when you reach the customer’s home. Not now. Remember — purple means you have arrived.
Maps is open. You can see two lines at the top — the first is your location, the second is the customer’s address.
This blue round dot — you are standing right here at this moment.
And this red balloon — the customer’s home. This is where you have to reach.
And this line of blue dots in the middle — this is your route. Just walk along it, that is all.
You will also see light grey lines. Those are other routes, a little longer. Ignore them — the dark blue line is yours.
Look at the top — car, bike, bus, and a walking man.
You are going on foot, so tap the walking man icon. It turned blue — that means it is selected.
It says twenty-four minutes here, and the distance is about two kilometers. Meaning it will take twenty-four minutes on foot.
And now the most important button — this dark green button at the bottom left. Press it. From here, Maps starts speaking and guiding you.
Look, the journey has started. This green board on top — the most useful thing. It shows your next turn.
This straight-up arrow on the board — means keep going straight. No turning.
And below it, a small left arrow — meaning after that, turn left. Maps tells you in advance.
This blue arrow — this is you. As you walk, the arrow moves forward with you.
And on top, the same red balloon — the customer’s home. Take the arrow to the balloon.
On the right, this speaker icon. If you cannot hear the voice, tap it once. Then Maps will speak — “In two hundred meters, turn left.”
If the map shifts around and the blue arrow stops being visible, press this white button on the left. The blue arrow will come back to the centre.
At the bottom you can always see — how much time and distance is left.
And this red button — for closing the route. Never press it before you reach the customer’s home.
Now practice. First one — easy. I will walk you through it.
The board says go straight. So look — the blue arrow is moving ahead on the blue dots.
Now the board changed — a left arrow. It means turn left from here.
And the arrow turned. That is all there is to Maps — watch the board, keep walking.
Second practice — a little harder. Watch carefully.
There is a place here where the road ahead is also open. Your mind will say — keep going straight.
But the board shows a left arrow. If you keep going straight — look, the arrow turned red. You left the route.
So remember — trust the board and the voice, not your eyes. Do what Maps says. That is the biggest lesson.
Third practice — the hardest. But there is nothing to fear.
Suppose the phone is in your pocket and the screen turns off. Do not worry — the voice keeps playing. Maps keeps speaking.
Take out the phone, turn on the screen — the route is right where you left it. Nothing is lost.
Now one more fear. Suppose you miss the turn and walk into the wrong lane.
Watch what happens. Maps does not get angry. It quietly makes a new route for you — this new blue line.
So when you take a wrong turn, do not stop, do not run back. Just keep walking and watch the new blue line.
Keep walking... just a little more... and now the arrow is reaching the red balloon.
You have arrived! You are standing outside the customer’s home. Maps’ work is done.
Now come back to your app and press the purple button at the bottom — “Mark Aa Gaya”. It means: I have arrived.
Very good! Now five small questions. I will speak out each question and all the answers. You have to tap the right answer on the screen.
Where does the next turn show?
Green board on top
Red button at the bottom
Speaker on the right
Right! The green board shows the next turn.
No. The next turn always shows on the green board at the top. Try again.
Who are you on the map?
Blue arrow
Red balloon
Grey line
Absolutely right! The blue arrow is you. The red balloon is the customer’s home.
No. The red balloon is the customer’s home — you are the blue arrow. Try again.
You cannot hear Maps. What will you press?
Speaker icon
Red button at the bottom
White button on the left
Right! Press the speaker and the voice comes back.
No. The red button will close the route. For sound, press the speaker icon. Try again.
Took a wrong turn. What will you do now?
Keep walking, Maps will make a new route
Press the red button and close Maps
Run back to the same spot
Exactly right! Maps makes a new route by itself. Just keep walking.
No. There is no need to close Maps or run back. Keep walking — a new route will form on its own.
You reached the customer’s home. What will you press in the app?
Purple button at the bottom
Green phone icon
Emergency at the top
Right! The purple button — “Mark Aa Gaya”.
No. On arriving, press the purple button at the bottom. Try again.
Now tap the right answer.
Shabash! Five out of five. You have learnt Maps.
Very good! You got some questions right on the first try. You can retake the quiz if you like.
